sections.title: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats

blocks.text: At ZX Bank, the security of your digital banking experience is our top priority. Here’s how we protect you from online threats:

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
1. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

items.text: Biometric Login: Secure access via fingerprint or facial recognition on the ZX Bank Asia app.
OTP Verification: Transactions require a One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile/email.
Device Registration: New device logins trigger verification steps.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
2. AI-driven Fraud Detection

items.text: Real-Time Monitoring: AI systems monitor for suspicious activities and flag unusual account behavior instantly.
Fraud Alerts: Customers receive immediate alerts for any unauthorized or suspicious transaction attempts.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
3. End-to-End Encryption

items.text: Encrypted Transactions: All communications and financial transactions are secured with industry-standard 256-bit SSL/TLS encryption.
Secure Storage: Sensitive customer data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
4. Session Timeout & Auto-Logout

items.text: Automatic Logout: User sessions automatically expire after periods of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access.
Timeout Alerts: Prompt warnings before app or online session expiry.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
5. Secure Fund Transfer Controls

items.text: Transaction Limits: Daily/transaction limits for transfers, especially for new payees or high-risk transactions.
Beneficiary Verification: Adding new beneficiaries requires additional authentication.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
6. Regular Security Updates

items.text: App Patching: Frequent updates to the ZX Bank Asia mobile app patch vulnerabilities and enhance defenses.
Phishing Protection: Built-in app features detect phishing links and sites, alerting users to potential threats.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
7. User Education

items.text: Financial Literacy Campaigns: Regular alerts and campaigns educating customers on safe banking practices (how to recognize scams, avoid phishing, etc.).
24/7 Support: Dedicated helpline and in-app AI assistant "Zia" for instant security advice.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
8. Transaction Notifications

items.text: Instant Alerts: SMS, email, and push notifications for every transaction and change to account settings.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats
9. Secure Remittance Corridors

items.text: Vetted Partners: Cross-border services only with verified financial partners.
Blockchain-based Authentication: For select regional remittances to prevent tampering and improve transparency.

location.heading: ZX Bank – Safety Features Against Online Threats

blocks.text:
Your security is our mission:
Stay vigilant, never share your passwords or OTPs, and contact ZX Bank support if you notice any suspicious activity.
